measurement.api: closed-loop concurrent C++ core index search; one shared index per process
measurement.workload: same 1000 held-out queries repeated three times total, partitioned across workers
measurement.qps: total completed queries / full process timed-block wall time
measurement.p95: pooled actual search-call latency, including global rate/depth queue waits
measurement.memory: total process RSS/Windows working set while all worker TLS contexts remain alive
measurement.io_budget: one shared IOPS bucket, byte bucket and total depth 8; no per-worker multiplication
measurement.baseline: one-worker data reused from earlier CI hosts; same indexes/parameters, different runner instances
